confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge and city context, not checked against live listings or booking pages. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately certain; accommodation has wider seasonal uncertainty for July. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship because direct knowledge is less precise.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against comparable Central and Southeast European capitals, placing Bucharest between Sofia and Budapest on typical restaurant and hotel levels.
